name: Grade 10 Statistics & Probability: Quiz 4
description: Descriptive statistics, variance, standard deviation, and probability distributions.

questions.question: Given data set [4, 8, 6, 5, 3, 2, 8, 9, 2, 5], what is the sample median?
questions.explanation: Sorted: 2, 2, 3, 4, 5, 5, 6, 8, 8, 9 — average of 5th and 6th items is 5.0.

questions.question: Why does standard deviation increase when an extreme outlier is added to a symmetric dataset?

options.A: The sample median doubles regardless of sample size
options.B: Squared deviations from the mean amplify outliers substantially
options.D: Extreme values are counted twice in frequency tables

questions.explanation: Standard deviation averages squared deviations from the mean, so extreme values magnify variance and SD.
